exitCriteria.title: Every performance and accessibility budget in section 12.7 passes in CI
exitCriteria.reason: The budget and accessibility contract checkers both run as required steps on the branch gate.

exitCriteria.title: 8 of 10 participants complete 4 of 5 core tasks unassisted in each language
exitCriteria.reason: No usability study has been run. This requires 10 English and 10 French non-GIS participants and cannot be derived from code or simulated.

exitCriteria.title: French page count equals English page count, with zero missing strings
exitCriteria.reason: The bilingual checker enforces route-pair parity across every locale route and fails on a missing route or a missing locale content token, and it runs as a required CI step.

exitCriteria.title: A test that renders a figure without provenance fails the type check
exitCriteria.reason: The policy component type test asserts, through expected type errors, that a figure missing provenance, evidence, confidence or coverage cannot be constructed, and that an unknown cannot be constructed as a figure.

exitCriteria.title: A test that renders an unknown value produces an en dash and a reason, never a zero
exitCriteria.reason: Every unknown marker renders U+2013 followed by the localized reason, and the tests assert the en dash, the reason, and the absence of a zero in both languages. The reason itself is now held to the same standard: a malformed sidecar read off disk can carry a missing or non-integer year, record count, or class value, and tests/raster-grid-hazards.test.ts asserts that no Unknown reason interpolates the words undefined, null, or NaN into either language.

ownerBlockers.reason: No usability study has been run. This requires 10 English and 10 French non-GIS participants and cannot be derived from code or simulated.

countingBoundary: An unweighted count of the five literal Phase 3 exit criteria published in section 16 of the controlling plan. It is not a cumulative maturity percentage: Version 2.1 assigns Phase 3 no such score and records it by evidence instead. Four passing criteria do not mean the phase is four fifths done. Real national place content, admitted Phase 2 aggregates, moderated bilingual usability testing, independent accessibility review, professional translation, legal review, and production-content approval all remain open.
